summary: Editor card table now covers every UPDATE-1 CardDef field with decimal-capable inputs, the evolution checkbox and a 36/26 deck hint are in the params form, and Export/Import/Reset are kept. Interpretations screen already lists major entries first, so it is unchanged. Typecheck, test (77/77) and build all pass; commit 45f67f1 on lane/upd1-t3.

done.what: Card table rebuilt to CardDef columns (cost C/N/O2, biomass C/N/P, growth and yield C/N/P/O2, upkeep, release C/N/P, lifespan, tags, can eat, eats alive, copies, text); removed fields not present in the editor; optional nested pools drop empty keys and the whole object when empty.
NumberInput uses step=any, parses with Number, keeps the raw typed text while focused, and returns undefined for empty optional fields (0 for required fields).

evidence.test: UI event-level check (editing cost to 0.5 calls onChange)
evidence.result: not run: no DOM test library installed; verified by code reading only

done.what: Params form: 'Evolution / adaptation mechanics' checkbox bound to params.evolutionEnabled with help text; deck total excludes adaptation cards when off and the hint expects 36 (on) or 26 (off).

evidence.test: UI event-level check (unchecking sets evolutionEnabled false)
evidence.result: not run: verified by code reading only

done.what: Import failure message: 'Import failed: <importRuleset error>. The current ruleset is unchanged.' (trailing period de-duplicated); onChange is not called on failure. Export and Reset unchanged.

evidence.result: not run: verified by code reading only

done.what: Interpretations screen: major entries listed first under 'Questions for the rule authors', then 'Other inferences'. No change needed.

decisions.text: Required number fields still fall back to 0 when emptied (the brief said empty gives undefined), because Params and card fields are typed as required numbers.
eatsAlive is stored as an explicit boolean (false when unchecked) rather than removed.
Deck total hint excludes adaptation-kind cards when evolution is off, and the table still lists them.
Number input keeps the raw DOM text while focused so half-typed decimals are not overwritten; the draft is cleared on blur.

gaps: No DOM test environment (no jsdom or testing-library in node_modules), so the three UI acceptance behaviors (decimal onChange, evolution uncheck, v1 import message) were verified by reading the code, not by running them.
Alley CLI was located at the plugin cache path and used for context preview and graph impact; no Seeds or Mulch writes were made.
